BIOM10-fit: The MAPK signalling cascade of Kholodenko (2000), a classic three-tier kinase cascade.
MAPK-HF96-layout: Ultrasensitivity in the MAPK cascade (Huang & Ferrell, 1996).
Genetic-2000Elo: The repressilator: a synthetic oscillating network of gene regulators (Elowitz & Leibler, 2000).
brusselator: The Brusselator: a classic chemical oscillator in which X catalyses its own formation.
Olsen2003_peroxidase: Oscillations of the enzyme peroxidase (Olsen, Hauser & Kummer, 2003).
YeastGlycolysis: Yeast glycolysis (Pritchard & Kell, 2002), simulating a fall in external glucose.
PK_fit2: Yeast glycolysis (Pritchard & Kell, 2002): an alternative version of the YeastGlycolysis model.
NF-kappaB: Oscillations in NF-κB signalling (Nelson et al., 2004).
CircadianClock: The fruit-fly circadian clock, driven by the PER and TIM genes (Leloup & Goldbeter, 1999).
array_1d: Calcium oscillations (Kummer et al., 2000), repeated across a row of 20 compartments.
DimericMWC-stiff: An allosteric (MWC) dimeric enzyme, and a deliberately 'stiff', hard-to-solve model.
LM-test1: A Michaelis–Menten enzyme progress curve, originally built as a parameter-fitting example.
turing_base: Turing patterns: a two-species reaction–diffusion example.
